verdict.rationale: Featurebase's own docs say it automatically notifies relevant users when their requests are shipped, which covers the core of the story for one status transition. Webhooks firing on status changes are a developer building block and earn no credit here. missing for 10: documented notifications for status changes other than 'shipped' (e.g. planned, in progress), details on notification channels and configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can automatically notify customers when the status of their requested feature changes

citations.quote: Featurebase automatically notifies all relevant users when their requests are shipped. No more manual follow-ups.
